transcription: 2026-11-12. Kamps Table 3 and Table 4 from the PDF text layer, checked against rendered page images. All 95 (mCO2, p) pairs were matched against the Ermatchkov 2006 Table 6 text layer; the only difference is 5.063 MPa (Kamps) vs 5.062 MPa (reprint) at 354.35 K, 1.995 mol/kg, mCO2 2.606. Column p_MPa is the Kamps value; p_reprint_MPa keeps the reprint. T_K is the Ermatchkov 2006 corrected temperature of the same block, row order identical. Table 6 lies on printed p.1794 and Kamps Table 4 on p.2667 (the PZ data map gave p.1795 and p.2666).
uncertainty: Pressure: ±0.1 % of the maximum reading of the transducer used, 4 MPa or 10 MPa (±4 or ±10 kPa); the paper does not say which transducer measured each row, so a row above 4 MPa is ±10 kPa and a row at or below 4 MPa is ±4 or ±10 kPa. Below 0.1 MPa the uncertainty 'can reach up to 10 %' (p.2667), which is below 10 kPa there. Inputs: mPZ < ±0.1 % relative; charged CO2 ±0.008 g of up to ~5 g; solvent mass ≤ ±0.7 % relative (p.2664). Printed temperatures ±0.1 K but 0.6–1.8 K low (Ermatchkov 2006 p.1792).
